title: "About"

Here I post some interesting PHREEQC use cases that I came across. I minimize use of AI for text writing, so no long explanations. 
I mostly use python to generate and run PHREEQC scripts. Occasionally, I would use FiPy coupled with PHREEQC. 
My OS is linux and code  setup is optimized for that. If you cannot figure out how to use my codes on your OS, 
there is high chance you do not need it, and there is a simpler solution for your problem.

If you have questions feel free to contact me via [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maximyutkin).
